Amazon's major Labor Day 2026 deals are now live, with $50 off AirPods Pro 3 and the all-new AirTag 2 hitting an all-time low at just $20 each. But the star of today's 9to5Toys "Daily Dispatch" is Amazon's first cash discounts on the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro Mac mini, Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery packs starting at $39, and the 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 also at an all-time low of $200. Anker's Labor Day sale is also live with up to 58% off; Bose's 2026 Labor Day sale is live with up to $320 off; and be sure to grab the new Apple Polishing Cloth for $9 Prime shipping before it sells out. All the top picks are waiting below.

Amazon's 2026 major Labor Day deals are now live! Thousands of deals on Apple, Android, TVs, tech under $100, even starting from $5

One of the best Apple deals of the year: all-new 2026 AirTag 2 from just $20 each

  • AirTag 2 $24 (regular $29) — matching all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (regular $99) — new all-time low
  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (regular $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (regular $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (regular $129)

Amazon offers reservation discounts on the two cheapest all-new M6 Mac mini models

Following the launch of the major Labor Day sale, Amazon really seems eager for everyone to reserve the M6 Mac mini — they've slightly discounted the two cheapest configurations. The discount isn't huge, but this is basically the only reputable place where you can buy a brand-new M6 mini right now. Be sure to grab the Apple Polishing Cloth for $9 Prime shipping before stock runs out.

Yesterday evening we noticed Amazon had lowered the MSRP on the base 16GB/256GB model, and now the mid-tier 16GB/512GB has joined the discount lineup:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (regular $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (regular $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (regular $1,699)

You can see these discounts are very modest, given the new base model starts at $899, but honestly, these machines aren't even on sale yet (shipping starts September 22). If you plan to reserve without trade-in, saving a bit on gas money or coffee money doesn't hurt.

As of now, as expected, the all-new M6 Mac mini is still at full price at other Apple authorized resellers and Apple's own store. We haven't seen any discounts on the 24GB M6 or M5 Pro models yet, and we'll keep watching.

The latest Midnight Apple Watch SE 3 hits all-time low of $200 on Amazon

During Amazon's 2026 Labor Day sale launch, the 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 hits an all-time low of $200 — arguably one of the most affordable options among the current generation of Apple Watches we've tracked.

Amazon now has the Midnight 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 down to $199.99 with free shipping.

The regular price is $280, so it's now nearly 30% off MSRP, saving you $79.

  • Midnight 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 $200 (regular $280)

Act fast: AirPods 4 only $80 via Amazon Renewed

iPhone 17 Pro hits all-time low on Amazon, up to $290 off (Premium Renewed)

On the eve of the iPhone 18 Pro launch, Amazon's iPhone 17 Pro hits a new low once again. If you don't want to pay full price for the new Pro next month (which will surely be very expensive), and you don't want to wait over half a year for a refurbished unit, Amazon's highest-quality Renewed iPhone 17 Pro is now $290 off, with a one-year Amazon Renewed warranty.

For now, legitimate Amazon Renewed Premium listings are the most affordable place to buy an iPhone 17 Pro. Apple's official refurbished store doesn't even have stock, and we're talking about Amazon's highest-quality goods here, with a one-year Amazon Renewed warranty and battery life maintained at over 90% — a completely different class from regular refurbished units.

Both the 512GB and 1TB models have hit the lowest prices we've tracked:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,215 (new MSRP $1,499) — all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,215 (new MSRP $1,499) — all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,208 (new MSRP $1,499) — all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,166 (regular $1,299) — all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,171 (regular $1,299) — all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,170 (regular $1,299) — all-time low

All the links above will take you to legitimate Amazon Renewed Premium listings — beware of third-party sellers.

Don't know about you, but I'll really miss the 17 Pro's colorways. Although I've been wanting to see an all-black version, I might just keep mine for another year before upgrading.

Apple official Bumper case drops to clearance all-time low, under $13 (68% off)

Update 8/27: Black Apple iPhone Air Bumper is back in stock now, just $13.42 with Prime shipping — that's 66% off MSRP.

iPhone Air users take note, the Apple official Bumper case has dropped to a clearance all-time low on Amazon, under $13 with Prime shipping.

Amazon now has the Apple official iPhone Air Bumper starting from $12.64, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

Light Blue under $13 is the lowest price we've tracked on Amazon, down from the $39 MSRP, that's 68% off. Other colors are priced higher, and black has sold out — Light Blue at this price could run out of stock any moment.

That's right, this is just a simple Bumper case that wraps around the edges of the device, but we're talking about a great deal on an Apple official product. It lets your phone's design shine through, giving users who need basic protection an extra layer of security — though it only protects the edges, not the screen or camera module.
